paper.title: Mach-Mind-4-Flash Technical Report
paper.abstract: We present Mach-Mind-4-Flash, a 35B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) agentic model with 3B activated parameters. Through post-training optimization alone without scaling pre-training compute, the model achieves performance on par with or surpassing that of 100B-parameter-class models. By introducing scalable agentic interaction environments for large-scale reinforcement learning, the model attains significant performance gains on real-world application tasks. Our pipeline comprises three stage

summary.core_problem: 这篇技术报告要解决的是一个很现实的问题：在不继续显著扩大预训练算力的前提下，能否把一个推理时只激活 3B 参数的 35B MoE 基座，通过更强的 post-training 管线，推到接近甚至进入 100B 级模型的能力区间。更具体地说，作者面对的是三个耦合难题：一是 RL、蒸馏、multi-turn agent 训练通常是分裂的系统，工程和优化目标不统一；二是把 reasoning、general、agent 三类能力混在一个 reward mixture 里训，容易出现能力跷跷板；三是强推理模型常常输出过长，服务成本高，但简单压长度又容易 reward hack 或伤准确率。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究员，这篇工作的价值不在于它替代 pretrain，而在于它把 pretrain 之后还能榨出多少能力、以及这种能力提升依赖什么训练接口，讲得比较具体。它说明了一个趋势：当 base model 已经足够强时，post-training 的组织方式、奖励环境、专家分治、蒸馏目标和长度控制，可能决定了模型最终能否进入更高能力带。对 pretrain↔posttrain 接口的启发主要有三点。第一，统一的 RL/OPD 框架让“在线蒸馏 + 策略优化”成为连续谱，而不是两个割裂阶段，这对 mid-training 或 continual adaptation 很有参考意义。第二，先训专家再做多教师 on-policy 融合，提供了一种避免 reward mixture 相互干扰的路线。第三，长度压缩如果设计得当，可以在不明显伤害正确率的情况下显著降低推理 token 成本，这会反过来影响训练时对 verbose CoT 的偏好。
summary.technical_approach:
技术上有三根主线。

第一根是统一的 RL / On-Policy Distillation 基础设施。作者把 OPD 深度并入 RL 框架，用一个加权损失同时容纳蒸馏项和策略梯度项，通过调节系数 α、β 在 pure RL、pure OPD、joint RL+OPD 三种模式间切换。这里的关键不是“把两个 loss 相加”这么简单，而是把分布式调度、经验采样、在线 rollout、teacher supervision 放进同一套训练骨架里。这样做的好处是，蒸馏不再是离线、静态、与环境脱节的过程，而是可以直接监督 student 自己 rollout 出来的轨迹。报告里还提到支持多种 distillation objective，不只传统 MSE，还包括更适合分布匹配的 Forward_kl_TopK 等形式。

第二根是多专家并行训练，再用 Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation 融合。作者没有把所有任务混在一个大杂烩 reward 里训单一策略，而是按三条轨道分别训练 domain-specific RL experts：Reasoning 轨覆盖 Math、Code、STEM；General 轨覆盖 Instruction Following、Writing、Safety；Agent 轨覆盖 Tool-Use、DeepSearch、Code Agent、Claw Agent。每个专家配自己的数据合成、可验证奖励和训练策略，例如稀疏结果任务用两阶段 reward curriculum，多轮 agent 任务则放进可执行环境。之后做 MOPD：每个训练样本路由到对应冻结 teacher，student 在自己的 rollout 上接受 token-level reverse-KL 监督。这个设计的重点是并行化专家开发，减少顺序依赖，同时尽量保留各专家能力而不在融合时互相冲掉。

第三根是 HMPO，用于最后一步长度压缩。作者观察到强 reasoning policy 往往“过想”，输出过长。HMPO 的做法不是直接惩罚长度，而是先从正确 rollout 的中位长度导出 group-adaptive budget，再用 correctness-first 的乘性奖励结构，避免模型通过“更短但错误”的方式刷奖励。报告声称这种设计在数学上能防止短错答案的 reward hacking。更有意思的是，虽然 HMPO 只在数学上训练，但长度压缩效果能迁移到代码、科学和通用指令任务。
summary.experiments:
模型规模是 35B 参数 MoE，推理时激活 3B。系统层面，作者在 SonicMoE indexed grouped GEMM kernel 和 segmented shared-expert fusion 上做了算子与通信重叠优化，报告给出在 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 训练上最高 17% 的端到端提速。

能力结果方面，文中列出的代表性分数包括：AIME’26 92.70，LiveCodeBench-V6 80.91，IFEval 94.64，IFBench 82.82，Content-SafetyBench 98.20，Behavioral-SafetyBench 80.74，ClawBench 84.20，BFCL-v4 75.80。作者的主张是，这样的 post-training 结果使其能与 120B 级模型匹敌，并在部分任务上接近更大系统。这里需要保留一点审慎：这是技术报告口径，比较对象、评测设置和是否同等推理预算，需要读表格和附录细看。

更有研究价值的是训练策略本身带来的增益模式。报告强调，单一 heterogeneous reward mixture 会出现 capability see-saw，而分轨训练专家再蒸馏融合能缓解这一点。HMPO 则把生成长度压缩了 19%–46%，准确率损失最多 0.7 个百分点。这个结果说明长度控制不是简单的 decoding trick，而可以作为 policy optimization 的一部分来学。若这些数字在附录中经得起细看，它对高成本 CoT 模型的部署很有现实意义。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先抓三部分。第一是 Introduction，里面把整条管线的三根主线讲得最清楚：统一 RL/OPD、分轨专家 + MOPD、HMPO 长度压缩。第二是 Infra 部分，重点看 unified weighted loss、dynamic multi-teacher architecture，以及算子级优化到底改了什么。第三是实验章节里关于 expert fusion 和 HMPO 的消融，因为真正有方法含量的是“为什么分开训再融合比混训更稳”，以及“为什么长度压缩没有明显伤准确率”。

如果只给 30 分钟，建议看 Figure 2 一类的训练框架图、MOPD 的样本路由与 reverse-KL 定义、HMPO 的 reward 公式，再扫主表。若有 1 小时以上，值得细看各 agent 环境和 reward 设计，因为这部分决定了所谓 agentic RL 的信号质量。读的时候要特别留意三件事：比较是否在同等 test-time budget 下进行；多教师融合后是否真的保住了单专家峰值；HMPO 的泛化是否来自长度偏好改变，还是来自额外 RL 数据带来的副作用。

summary_en.core_problem: The report asks a practical question: how far can a relatively compact MoE base model be pushed through post-training alone, without scaling pretraining compute? Concretely, the target is a 35B-parameter MoE with only 3B activated parameters at inference, and the challenge is threefold: unify RL and distillation in one training system, avoid capability trade-offs when optimizing heterogeneous domains, and reduce the excessive verbosity of strong reasoning models without rewarding short but wrong outputs.
summary_en.importance: For foundation-model researchers, the main value is not that it replaces pretraining, but that it clarifies how much capability can still be extracted after pretraining and which interfaces matter. The report is especially relevant to the pretrain-posttrain boundary. It treats online distillation and policy optimization as a continuum rather than separate stages, proposes specialist RL tracks instead of a single mixed reward soup, and turns response-length control into a learned policy objective rather than a decoding heuristic. Those choices matter for mid-training, continual adaptation, and the economics of reasoning-heavy models.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work has three main components.

First, it builds a unified RL / On-Policy Distillation framework. Instead of running distillation as a separate offline pipeline, the authors integrate OPD into the RL training stack with a weighted objective combining a distillation term and a policy-gradient term. By adjusting coefficients, the same infrastructure can operate in pure RL, pure OPD, or joint mode. The important point is not merely adding two losses, but sharing rollout generation, distributed scheduling, experience handling, and online supervision. The report also mentions support for multiple distillation objectives beyond standard MSE, including distribution-matching forms such as Forward_kl_TopK.

Second, it trains multiple domain specialists and then fuses them through Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation. Rather than optimizing one policy on a heterogeneous reward mixture, the authors train separate RL experts across three tracks: Reasoning (Math, Code, STEM), General (Instruction Following, Writing, Safety), and Agent (Tool-Use, DeepSearch, Code Agent, Claw Agent). Each expert uses domain-specific synthetic data, verifiable rewards, and tailored curricula, such as two-stage reward schedules for sparse-outcome tasks and executable multi-turn environments for agent tasks. Fusion is done by routing each sample to the corresponding frozen teacher and supervising the student on its own rollouts with token-level reverse KL. This is designed to parallelize expert development and reduce the capability see-saw that often appears in mixed-domain RL.

Third, the final stage applies HMPO, a length-compression RL method. The motivation is that strong reasoning models often over-generate. HMPO derives a group-adaptive length budget from the median length of correct rollouts and uses a correctness-first multiplicative reward so that the model cannot gain by being shorter if it is wrong. The report claims this structure prevents short-answer reward hacking. An interesting detail is that HMPO is trained only on mathematics, yet the resulting brevity transfers to code, science, and instruction-following tasks.
summary_en.experiments:
The model is a 35B-parameter MoE with 3B activated parameters. On the systems side, the report attributes up to 17% end-to-end training speedup on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B to operator-level and communication-level optimizations, including SonicMoE indexed grouped GEMM kernels and segmented shared-expert fusion.

The headline task results reported in the text include AIME’26 at 92.70, LiveCodeBench-V6 at 80.91, IFEval at 94.64, IFBench at 82.82, Content-SafetyBench at 98.20, Behavioral-SafetyBench at 80.74, ClawBench at 84.20, and BFCL-v4 at 75.80. The claim is that this places the model in the range of 120B-class systems while keeping inference activation at 3B parameters. That comparison should be read carefully against evaluation settings and test-time budgets in the tables and appendix.

The more interesting experimental message is about training structure. The authors argue that a single heterogeneous reward mixture causes capability trade-offs, while specialist training followed by MOPD preserves or even improves expert performance in a unified student. HMPO reportedly reduces generation length by 19% to 46% with at most 0.7 percentage points of accuracy loss. If those numbers hold under close reading, they suggest that response compression can be learned as part of policy optimization rather than treated as a post hoc decoding constraint.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, focus on three parts. Start with the introduction, which lays out the full pipeline clearly: unified RL/OPD, specialist experts plus MOPD, and HMPO for length compression. Then read the infrastructure section for the weighted objective, the dynamic multi-teacher design, and the systems optimizations. Finally, go to the ablations around expert fusion and HMPO, because those sections carry the real methodological content.

If you only have 30 minutes, prioritize the training framework figure, the sample-routing and reverse-KL details of MOPD, the HMPO reward definition, and the main result tables. With more time, inspect the agent environments and reward construction, since the quality of those signals determines whether the reported gains are robust or mostly benchmark-specific. While reading, keep three questions in mind: whether comparisons use comparable test-time budgets, whether the fused student truly retains specialist peaks, and whether HMPO’s gains come from a genuine shift in policy length preference rather than simply from extra RL exposure.

recommendation.zh: 对预训练本身帮助有限，但它在讲一个更现实的问题：post-train 到底能榨出多少能力；先看 MOPD 和 mixed-reward 退化分析，别先信 headline。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it addresses a practical question: how much capability post-training can actually extract; read the MOPD and mixed-reward degradation parts first, not the headline claims.

paper.title: Single-Rollout Asynchronous Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is becoming increasingly important for post-training large language models (LLMs). Previous RL pipelines for LLMs were mostly synchronous and batch-interleaved, which is inefficient for long-horizon agentic tasks. Recently, asynchronous RL has emerged as a more efficient alternative by updating the model as rollouts arrive. However, existing asynchronous RL systems often emphasize throughput, while leaving training stability and task effectiveness largely underexplore

summary.core_problem: 面向长horizon智能体任务的LLM异步强化学习（RL），在提升GPU利用率的同时，面临策略滞后引发的off-policy偏差大、训练不稳定，以及GRPO等组式采样方法与异步机制、单轨迹反馈的智能体场景不匹配的问题。
summary.importance: 对预训练后长轨迹智能体任务的RL对齐有实际参考价值，解决了异步RL训练的稳定性与组采样不兼容问题，为提升RL阶段的GPU利用率与训练效率提供了可落地方案。
summary.technical_approach: 提出单轮异步优化（SAO），核心有四点：1）采用token级重要性采样，结合更严格的双边裁剪与掩码，缓解不同策略滞后下的off-policy偏差；2）用单轮采样替代GRPO的组式采样，从根源上避免组内等待带来的策略滞后，也适配单轨迹反馈的在线/智能体场景；3）优化价值模型训练流程——critic更新频率高于actor，且采用冻结注意力的方式微调价值模型，降低训练开销；4）针对多轮智能体轨迹（含环境反馈观测），推导跳过观测token的token级GAE估计器，避免观测token引入的噪声传播。
summary.experiments: 在SWE-Bench Verified、AIME2025、BeyondAIME、HMMT、IMOAnswerBench等编程和数学推理基准上测试，SAO可稳定训练约1000步，性能优于改进版GRPO；单轮采样策略适配模拟在线学习场景，可适应动态环境变化。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注核心方法部分的SAO设计，尤其是token级裁剪、单轮采样、skip-observation GAE三个创新点；实验部分关注异步训练的稳定性曲线和与GRPO的性能对比，预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) for long-horizon agentic LLM tasks improves GPU utilization but suffers from severe off-policy drift due to policy lag, and existing group-wise sampling methods like GRPO are incompatible with asynchronous pipelines and single-trajectory feedback in agentic settings.
summary_en.importance: Provides practical insights for stable and efficient agentic RL in LLM post-training, addressing key pain points of asynchronous training stability and group-sampling incompatibility for long-horizon coding and reasoning workloads.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Single-rollout Asynchronous Optimization (SAO) with four key components: 1) Token-level importance sampling with strict double-sided clipping and masking to mitigate off-policy drift under varying policy lag; 2) Single-rollout sampling per prompt to replace group-wise GRPO sampling, eliminating intra-group wait latency and fitting single-trajectory agent/online settings; 3) Improved value model training with more frequent critic updates than actor, plus frozen-attention fine-tuning for the value model to reduce overhead; 4) A skip-observation token-level GAE estimator for multi-turn agent trajectories that excludes environment observation tokens from advantage computation to avoid noise propagation.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on agentic coding and math benchmarks including SWE-Bench Verified, AIME2025, BeyondAIME, HMMT, and IMOAnswerBench. SAO stably trains for ~1000 steps and consistently outperforms improved GRPO. The single-rollout design also performs well in simulated online learning with dynamic environment changes.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the core method section for SAO design, especially token-level clipping, single-rollout sampling, and skip-observation GAE. Skim experimental results for stability curves and GRPO comparison. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 单rollout采样打破GRPO组归一化的常规思路，对做agent RL训练的人有启发，重点看方法和稳定性分析部分。
recommendation.en: Single-rollout sampling challenges the group-normalization convention in GRPO; relevant for researchers working on agentic RL training stability.

paper.title: Beyond Static Evaluation: Building Simulation Environments for Scalable Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) evolve into autonomous agents, traditional static evaluation fails to capture multi-step decision-making. We introduce AgenticAI-Supervisor, an API and UI-driven RL Gym environment that decouples environment creation from scalable execution. By moving to verifiable execution outcomes, the platform generates high-fidelity traces and applies multi-dimensional reward shaping. Critically, our framework mitigates reward hacking through rigorous internal state validatio

summary.core_problem: 解决静态 benchmark 无法支撑 agent 多步决策优化的问题，尝试构建可扩展的 agentic RL 交互环境。
summary.importance: 价值在于把 agent 训练从静态评测转向可验证执行环境，并强调 reward hacking 控制。这对 post-train 与 RL 信号质量有一定启发，但离预训练本体较远，且当前展示仍偏平台雏形。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AgenticAI-Supervisor，一个 API/UI 驱动的 RL Gym 环境，将环境构建与大规模执行解耦；通过可验证执行结果生成轨迹，并使用多维 reward shaping，同时用内部状态校验和测试来抑制 reward hacking。
summary.experiments: 摘要只给出 customer support agent 个案，展示闭环反馈可用于模型优化；没有看到通用 agent 基线、跨任务泛化、规模曲线或 RL 收敛分析，因此证据强度有限。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the mismatch between static benchmarks and the needs of optimizing multi-step LLM agents, by building a scalable interactive environment for agentic RL.
summary_en.importance: The main value is the shift from static evaluation to verifiable execution environments, with explicit attention to reward-hacking control. That is somewhat relevant to post-training signal quality, but still fairly far from core pretraining research and currently looks like an early platform paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces AgenticAI-Supervisor, an API/UI-driven RL Gym environment that decouples environment creation from scalable execution. It uses verifiable execution outcomes to collect traces, applies multi-dimensional reward shaping, and validates internal state to reduce reward hacking.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract only mentions a customer-support-agent case study showing a closed-loop optimization setup. There is no evidence yet of strong general-agent baselines, cross-task transfer, scaling behavior, or RL convergence analysis, so the empirical support appears limited.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 RL 信号质量和 reward hacking，可只看环境设计与验证部分；目前更像平台提案，证据还不够硬。
recommendation.en: Read only the environment and reward-validation design if you care about RL signal quality; for now it looks more like a platform proposal than a settled result.

paper.title: TRIAGE: Role-Typed Credit Assignment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning requires assigning credit to environment-facing actions such as searches, clicks, edits, navigation commands, and object interactions. Standard GRPO uses the final verifier outcome as a uniform advantage over all action tokens. This outcome signal is useful but structurally incomplete: it punishes useful exploration in failed rollouts and reinforces redundant or regressive actions in successful rollouts. We propose TRIAGE, a role-typed credit assignment framework t

summary.core_problem: TRIAGE 处理的是 agentic RL 里的 credit assignment：最终 verifier 只告诉一条轨迹成败，但 GRPO 会把同一个 outcome advantage 均匀分给所有动作 token 或动作片段。这会压制失败轨迹中的有效探索，也会奖励成功轨迹中的冗余动作或退步动作。
summary.importance: 这篇工作不直接改预训练目标，但对 LLM post-train 的训练信号质量有启发。它把 agent 轨迹中的环境交互动作当作基本决策单元，而不是普通 token span。这个视角对工具调用、搜索、代码编辑、网页导航类 RL 很关键：训练信号不能只按最终结果分配，还要区分动作在局部过程中的角色。贡献更偏方法设计和诊断框架，适合泛读。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是给每个 environment-facing segment 增加一个语义角色轴。TRIAGE 用结构化 LLM judge 对局部上下文中的动作片段分类，角色包括 decisive progress、useful exploration、no-progress infrastructure、regression。分类器不直接替代 verifier，也不输出自由形式 reward；它只做局部语义诊断。随后用固定的 role-conditioned rule 把角色映射为有界的 segment-level process reward：决定性进展继承较强 outcome-aligned credit，有用探索给有限正向 credit，无进展基础操作压到接近 0，退步动作即使出现在成功轨迹中也被抑制。这样保留 GRPO 的最终 outcome advantage 作为主方向，同时用角色标签修正局部 credit。论文还给出一个理论解释：如果只能观测角色标签，role-conditioned correction 是均方误差意义下的最优片段校正；当固定角色常数与该最优校正对齐时，可以降低 advantage estimation error，并对应更低方差的 policy gradient。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 WebShop、Search-QA、ALFWorld 这类需要搜索、点击、导航、对象交互的 agentic 任务。对比项包括标准 GRPO、使用同一 judge 和上下文窗口的标量 LLM process-reward baseline，以及 outcome-supervised shared-backbone value baseline。论文声称 TRIAGE 在这些任务上相对上述基线有稳定收益，并用人工标注片段和角色诊断解释收益来源：失败轨迹中的 useful exploration 不再被全量惩罚，成功轨迹中的 regression 不再被 outcome reward 掩盖。给出的材料没有包含具体提升幅度和完整表格数字，因此不宜外推其规模。
summary.reading_guide: 建议用 20 到 30 分钟泛读。重点看 Introduction 对 outcome-only credit 两个盲点的定义，以及方法部分中四类 role 的边界。理论部分只需抓住 MSE-optimal correction 和 advantage variance 的直觉，不必深究每一步推导。实验部分优先看与 scalar process reward baseline 的对比，因为这个对比回答的是“角色标签是否比普通 dense reward 多提供信息”。如果关注 agent RL recipe，可进一步看人工标注诊断，判断角色分类是否稳定、是否依赖 judge 偏好。

summary_en.core_problem: TRIAGE addresses credit assignment in agentic RL. A final verifier can judge whether a trajectory succeeds, but vanilla GRPO assigns the same outcome advantage to all action tokens or segments. This penalizes useful exploration in failed rollouts and reinforces redundant or regressive actions in successful rollouts.
summary_en.importance: The paper is more relevant to RL post-training than to base pretraining, but it is useful for understanding training-signal quality in tool-use and environment-interaction settings. Its main contribution is to treat environment-facing segments, such as searches, clicks, edits, and object interactions, as the credit-assignment unit. This matters because outcome-only supervision is too coarse for long agent trajectories.
summary_en.technical_approach: TRIAGE adds a semantic role axis on top of the outcome axis. A structured LLM judge classifies each local segment into one of four roles: decisive progress, useful exploration, no-progress infrastructure, or regression. The judge is used as a role classifier, not as an unconstrained reward model. A fixed role-conditioned rule then maps labels to bounded process rewards or penalties. Decisive progress receives strong outcome-aligned credit; useful exploration receives bounded positive credit; infrastructure is damped toward zero; regression is suppressed even when the trajectory eventually succeeds. The final verifier outcome remains the primary optimization direction under GRPO. The paper also gives a theoretical justification: role-conditioned correction is the MSE-optimal segment correction measurable from role labels alone, and aligned role constants can reduce advantage-estimation error.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers WebShop, Search-QA, and ALFWorld. Baselines include standard GRPO, a scalar LLM-derived process-reward baseline using the same judge and context window, and an outcome-supervised shared-backbone value baseline. TRIAGE is reported to improve consistently over these baselines. Manual segment labels and role diagnostics are used to explain where the gains come from: preserving useful exploration in failed trajectories and suppressing regressive actions inside successful ones. The provided text does not include exact improvement numbers, so the magnitude should be read from the full tables before drawing strong conclusions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the introduction for the two failure modes of outcome-only credit, then inspect the method section for the four-role taxonomy and the fixed role-to-reward mapping. The most informative experimental comparison is against the scalar process-reward baseline, because it tests whether role typing adds information beyond dense reward scoring. The theory section is worth a light pass for the MSE-optimal correction argument, but the practical value depends more on judge reliability and role-label stability.

recommendation.zh: GRPO信用分配的关键改进，角色分段奖励的思路可直接复现用于R1-style推理RL训练，重点看§3的规则设计和正确性证明
recommendation.en: Key improvement to GRPO credit assignment; role-based segment reward design is directly reproducible for R1-style reasoning RL training, focus on §3 rule design and correctness proof

paper.title: ECHO: Prune to act, trace to learn with selective turn memory in agentic RL
paper.abstract: Long-horizon language agents must repeatedly interact with tools, accumulate evidence, and make decisions under bounded context windows. Existing context-management methods make such rollouts feasible by truncating distant history, folding past turns into summaries, or selecting compact memory states. However, these breakthroughs introduce two coupled limitations. First, as the number of turns grows, historical observations are progressively removed or collapsed into compressed states, making it

summary.core_problem: ECHO 解决长程工具调用 agent 在有限上下文下的两个耦合问题：行动时需要压缩历史，训练时又需要知道最终奖励应该回传到哪些早期证据 turn。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是核心贡献，但对 agentic RL 和 post-train 训练信号设计有启发。它强调 context management 不能只看推理时能否塞进窗口，还要保留 provenance，也就是被压缩信息来自哪个原始环境 turn。这个视角对长程 RL、deep research agent、tool-use 数据构造都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
ECHO 把历史管理拆成三个部分：history state、bounded-context reconstruction 和 source-level traceability。每个工具调用 turn 完成后，系统写入一条 compact memory record，包含局部 finding 和 source-turn pointer。远端历史不是被滚动摘要折叠成一个不可追踪状态，而是保留为一组带来源指针的 memory records。当上下文预算紧张时，策略选择有用 memory，再把这些 memory 与近期交互一起重建成下一步的 policy context。

训练上，ECHO 不把 final-outcome advantage 均匀或密集地分配到整条轨迹的所有生成 token，而是利用 memory selection 中保留的 source indices，把正向 credit 路由到 final answer、被选中的历史 evidence turns、对应 memory findings，以及执行 memory selection 的动作。它和 rolling summary 的区别在于：summary 可以延长 rollout，但原始证据来源容易丢失；ECHO 牺牲一部分自由压缩能力，换取训练时可追踪的证据路径。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 BrowseComp-Plus 和一组 zero-shot benchmarks，并在 dense 与 MoE backbones 上报告结果。提供内容中的主要结论是：相比 rolling-summary training，ECHO 提高准确率，同时减少 turn proliferation 和 trajectory volume，训练更集中于有用证据链。具体数值在给定内容中未完整展示，因此不宜过度解读幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Introduction 和方法定义部分，重点看 context-managed multi-turn RL interface、selective turn memory、provenance-guided token-level credit assignment。实验部分主要看和 rolling summary 的对比，以及 turn 数、trajectory volume、accuracy 三者之间的关系。预计 20 到 30 分钟可以把核心思想读完；若关心 agent RL 训练实现，再细看 GRPO 形式下 advantage 如何按 source indices 分配。

summary_en.core_problem: ECHO addresses a long-horizon agent training problem: context managers help agents act under bounded windows, but collapsed or summarized history makes it hard to assign final-outcome credit back to the original evidence turns.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly relevant to agentic RL and post-training rather than base pretraining. The useful idea is that context compression should preserve provenance. A long-rollout agent needs not only a compact context for acting, but also a trace that tells the learner which earlier observations supported the successful answer. That distinction matters for tool-use RL, deep-research agents, and synthetic trajectory generation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper formalizes context-managed multi-turn RL with separate notions of history state, bounded-context reconstruction, and source-level traceability. ECHO writes a compact memory record after each completed tool-use turn. Each record contains a local finding and a pointer to the original source turn. Distant history is kept as a non-collapsing set of such records. When the context budget becomes tight, the policy selects useful memory records and reconstructs the next context from those records plus recent interactions.

The learning rule uses the same source indices. Instead of applying a trajectory-level positive advantage broadly across all generated spans, ECHO routes credit to the final answer, selected historical evidence turns, their memory findings, and the memory-selection actions that built the reconstructed context. Compared with rolling summaries, the method gives up fully collapsed state compression in exchange for evidence addressability during RL.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are reported on BrowseComp-Plus and several zero-shot benchmarks, with both dense and MoE backbones. The stated result is that ECHO improves accuracy relative to rolling-summary training while reducing excessive turns and total trajectory volume. The provided text does not include the detailed tables or exact numerical gains, so the safest reading is that the contribution is the traceable-memory training interface and its empirical validation against summary-based context management.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction for the motivation, then read the formal interface for context-managed multi-turn RL and the sections on selective turn memory and provenance-guided credit assignment. The experiments are most useful for checking whether accuracy gains come with fewer turns and smaller trajectory volume, rather than merely longer rollouts. A 20–30 minute pass is enough for the main idea; implementation details are worth reading only if building RL pipelines for tool-using agents.

recommendation.zh: 做agentic RL或长上下文预训练的看方法部分即可，源索引记忆绑定RL信用分配的思路可以迁移到预训练的记忆机制设计中
recommendation.en: Check the method section if working on agentic RL or long-context pretraining; the source-indexed memory tied to RL credit assignment is transferable to pretraining memory mechanism design

paper.title: OPID: On-Policy Skill Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Outcome-based reinforcement learning provides a stable optimization backbone for language agents, but its sparse trajectory-level rewards provide little guidance on which intermediate decisions should be reinforced or suppressed. On-policy self-distillation offers dense token-level supervision, yet existing skill-conditioned variants often rely on external skill memories or retrieved privileged context, which are costly to maintain and can be mismatched with the state distribution induced by the

summary.core_problem: 长时程语言代理的 outcome-based RL（如 GRPO）只有稀疏的轨迹级奖励，难以做中间决策的 credit assignment；而现有 skill-conditioned 自蒸馏往往依赖外部 skill memory/检索到的特权上下文，既有维护成本，也容易与当前 on-policy 状态分布失配。论文要解决的是：能否从“当前策略自己跑出来的完整轨迹”里提取分布匹配的技能监督，并把它变成密集的 token 级训练信号，同时推理时不引入额外检索或 analyzer。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身的直接贡献有限，更像是 agentic post-train/RL 的训练信号设计。但它提供了一个对预训练研究仍有价值的点：把“轨迹后验信息（hindsight）→ 自监督/自蒸馏信号”的管线做成严格 on-policy、分布匹配、可内化（inference-free）的训练目标。这类思路在持续学习/continual post-train、以及把 RL 信号转成更稳定的 token-level shaping 上，可能比纯 outcome 优化更稳，也更接近可规模化的数据闭环。
summary.technical_approach:
OPID 的核心是把一条已完成的 on-policy 轨迹转写成两级自然语言技能，并用这些技能构造“同一输出在不同上下文下的 logprob 差”作为自蒸馏优势（advantage）来做策略更新。

1) 技能抽取（hindsight skill extraction）：对每条完成轨迹生成两类技能文本：
- episode-level skill：总结整条轨迹的工作流/避免失败的规则，粒度粗但覆盖全程。
- step-level skill：只在关键时刻给出状态条件化的局部指导，粒度细但稀疏。
论文动机是长时程交互里“全局流程”和“关键拐点决策”对成功都重要，但需要不同粒度的监督。

2) critical-first skill routing：先识别轨迹中的 critical timesteps（文中描述为关键决策点/易出错点），这些位置优先注入 step-level skill；其余位置回退到 episode-level skill。这样避免全程塞入细粒度技能导致噪声/不稳定，也避免只用全局技能导致对关键局部决策无约束。

3) on-policy self-distillation advantage：把“路由后的技能文本”作为额外上下文注入到交互历史中，用同一个旧策略对同一条 on-policy 响应分别在原上下文与技能增强上下文下打分，得到 token-level 的 log-probability shift。这个 shift 被当作偏好信号/优势项，与 episode-level 的 outcome advantage 结合，形成最终的更新目标。直观上：结果奖励负责方向，技能蒸馏负责把方向分解到哪些 token/哪些决策更该被强化。

4) 推理阶段：不需要技能抽取器、外部 skill 库或检索；技能只在训练时作为“特权上下文”产生梯度信号，最终被模型参数内化。
summary.experiments:
论文在 ALFWorld、WebShop、Search-based QA 上评估，并覆盖不同模型尺度。结论层面：OPID 相比纯 outcome-based RL、以及依赖外部 skill memory/检索的 skill-distillation 基线，在长时程任务成功率上更高，且更稳定。

但你给到的全文片段没有包含关键表格与具体数值（成功率提升幅度、cache/rollout 规模、训练步数、critical step 识别方式的消融等），因此无法可靠复述“提升了多少个百分点/在什么预算下”。如果要用于严肃的 recipe 复现，必须回到实验章节核对：
- 与 outcome-only（GRPO 类）相比的绝对提升；
- 与 SDAR/skill-conditioned distill 基线相比的差距；
- step-skill vs episode-skill 的单独贡献；
- critical-first routing 的必要性（随机路由/全用 episode/全用 step 的对照）；
- 训练稳定性指标（reward 方差、KL、loss spike）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 重点看方法部分对“skill 注入后重新打分同一输出”的目标函数定义：token-level logprob shift 如何变成 advantage，如何与 episode advantage 合并。
- 找到 critical timestep 的定义与实现细节：是基于失败模式、价值/优势、还是启发式规则；这决定了方法是否可迁移。
- 看消融：episode-skill/step-skill/路由策略分别带来什么增益；如果增益主要来自某个组件，复现时可先做最小实现。
- 看推理时是否完全不需要技能，以及训练时技能生成的成本（是否需要额外 LLM 标注、是否会成为瓶颈）。

summary_en.core_problem: Outcome-based RL for long-horizon language agents (e.g., GRPO-style) provides only sparse, trajectory-level rewards, making intermediate credit assignment weak. Prior skill-conditioned self-distillation often depends on external skill memories or retrieved privileged context, which is costly and can be off-distribution relative to the current on-policy interaction states. The paper asks: can we extract distribution-matched skill supervision purely from completed on-policy trajectories and turn it into dense token-level training signals, while requiring no skills/retrieval at inference time?
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an agentic post-training/RL signal-design paper rather than a pretraining recipe contribution. Still, it offers a reusable idea for foundation-model training loops: convert hindsight information from the model’s own rollouts into stable, on-policy, token-level shaping signals that can be internalized into parameters (no inference-time scaffolding). This is relevant to scalable continual post-train and to bridging sparse RL rewards with dense supervision without introducing off-policy retrieval artifacts.
summary_en.technical_approach:
OPID builds a strictly on-policy self-distillation pipeline by rewriting each completed trajectory into hierarchical natural-language “skills”, then using the same policy to rescore the same sampled outputs under skill-augmented context.

1) Hindsight skill extraction: from each finished on-policy trajectory, generate:
- Episode-level skills: global workflow summaries / failure-avoidance rules (coarse but broadly applicable).
- Step-level skills: state-conditioned guidance at pivotal timesteps (precise but sparse).

2) Critical-first skill routing: identify critical timesteps and inject step-level skills there; otherwise fall back to episode-level skills. This targets the granularity trade-off in long-horizon interaction: global guidance is stable but too coarse at decision bottlenecks; local guidance is accurate but should not be applied everywhere.

3) Skill-based self-distillation advantage: take the routed skill text as privileged context appended to the interaction history. Using the old policy, compute token-level log-prob shifts for the same on-policy response between (a) original context and (b) skill-augmented context. This shift acts as a dense preference/advantage signal and is combined with the episode-level outcome advantage for policy optimization.

4) Inference: no analyzer, no retrieval, no skill memory. Skills are training-only scaffolding whose effect is distilled into the policy parameters.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Focus on the objective: how token-level log-prob shifts are turned into an advantage term and how it is combined with the trajectory-level outcome advantage.
- Inspect how “critical timesteps” are defined and detected; this is the main portability bottleneck.
- Read the ablations for the hierarchy and routing; identify which component drives most of the gain.
- Check training-time overhead: how skills are generated (extra LLM calls or not) and whether that cost dominates.

recommendation.zh: 值得看方法部分：on-policy 轨迹内生技能监督是干净方向，但需检查 reward 与 distillation 是否互相泄漏。
recommendation.en: Read the method section: on-policy trajectory-derived skill supervision is a clean idea, but check whether reward signals and distillation targets leak into each other.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: Group-Graph Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Group-based Reinforcement Learning (RL) has significantly enhanced Large Language Models (LLMs) in agentic scenarios. To achieve finer-grained policy updates, recent agentic RL frameworks have shifted from trajectory-level to step-level training. However, long-horizon agentic RL suffers from severe reward sparsity and delay, as feedback is often deferred for dozens of interaction steps. While existing step-level frameworks refine training granularity, their credit assignment remains coarse-grain

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的是长程 Agent RL 中的信用分配问题：step-level 训练降低了上下文和显存压力，但仍把探索轨迹当成彼此独立的线性序列，导致稀疏、延迟奖励下的状态价值估计方差高，关键动作也难以被准确放大。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练本身不是直接贡献，更接近 Agent post-training 的算法改进。它的启发在于训练信号的组织方式：长程交互数据不应只按 trajectory 或 step 切开，还可以按状态转移结构重组。对做 RL pretrain、agentic mid-training 或环境交互数据训练的人来说，G2PO 提供了一个清晰的思路：先把采样轨迹还原成状态图，再在图上估计价值和优势，减少单条轨迹偶然性带来的噪声。
summary.technical_approach: G2PO 的核心做法有两步。第一，把多条 Agent 探索轨迹重构成状态转移图。相同或相似的环境观察被聚合成一个 state group，动作被看作从源状态到目标状态的有向边。第二，在图上重新定义价值和优势。状态价值不再由单条轨迹的最终结果决定，而是对同一 state group 中多个样本的结果做聚合，近似估计该状态通向成功的概率。动作优势则由边两端的价值增量给出，形式上接近 1-step TD error。与 GiGPO 这类只在同一局部状态内比较动作的方法不同，G2PO 会把全图所有边的 TD error 放入一个全局参考组做标准化，从而让跨状态、跨阶段的关键转移也能得到较高权重。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 WebShop、ALFWorld 和 AppWorld 三个长程 Agent benchmark，模型包括 Qwen-2.5-1.5B、7B 和 14B。论文报告 G2PO 相比 prompt-based 方法和 RL baseline 都有稳定收益。相对 GRPO，在 WebShop 上最高提升 22.2% success rate，在 ALFWorld 上最高提升 14.4%。AppWorld 用于验证复杂环境观察下的有效性。作者强调该方法主要改变 advantage 估计和样本组织方式，几乎不引入额外计算成本。文中还用状态价值方差分析说明，基于单条轨迹的估计容易受后续随机失败或偶然成功影响，而 state-group 聚合能缓解这一问题。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25 到 35 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中 Figure 1 对 trajectory-level、step-level 和 graph-level 视角的对比；方法部分重点看 state grouping 的定义、value aggregation 的公式、edge-centric advantage 以及全局标准化方式。实验部分优先看 WebShop/ALFWorld 的主表和关于状态价值方差、局部归一化与全局归一化的消融。需要特别留意 state similarity 如何判定，因为这是方法能否从 benchmark 迁移到真实网页、软件环境或多模态 Agent 的关键细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets credit assignment in long-horizon agentic RL. Step-level training reduces context growth, but it still treats exploration as isolated linear trajectories, which gives noisy value estimates and weak credit assignment under sparse delayed rewards.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense. Its value is in how it reorganizes interaction data before applying RL. For researchers working on RL-based agent training, RL pretraining, or environment-interaction mid-training, the main lesson is that trajectories can be lifted into a state-transition graph, and the training signal can be computed on that graph rather than on individual rollouts.
summary_en.technical_approach: G2PO reconstructs sampled agent trajectories into a directed state-transition graph. Identical or similar observations are grouped into state groups, and actions become edges between source and destination states. State value is estimated by aggregating outcomes over all states in the same group, instead of relying on one trajectory’s terminal reward. Action advantage is then computed from the value increment across an edge, which resembles a one-step TD error in sparse-reward tasks. Unlike local group methods such as GiGPO, which compare actions only within the same state, G2PO normalizes edge-level TD errors against a global reference group containing transitions from the whole graph. This gives more weight to transitions that make large absolute progress toward task success.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses WebShop, ALFWorld, and AppWorld with Qwen-2.5 models at 1.5B, 7B, and 14B scale. G2PO consistently improves over prompt-based methods and RL baselines. The reported gains over GRPO reach up to 22.2 percentage points in success rate on WebShop and 14.4 points on ALFWorld. AppWorld is used to test the method under more complex observations. The claimed overhead is minimal because the method changes the advantage estimation and grouping procedure rather than adding expensive model calls. The paper also analyzes variance in state-value estimation and argues that aggregating over state groups is less sensitive to accidental success or failure in a single rollout.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25 to 35 minutes. Focus on Figure 1 for the shift from trajectory-level and step-level views to a graph view. In the method section, read the definitions of state grouping, group-aggregated value estimation, edge-centric advantage, and global normalization. In the experiments, prioritize the main WebShop and ALFWorld tables, plus ablations on graph aggregation and local versus global normalization. The most important implementation detail to check is how observation similarity is defined, since this will determine whether the method transfers beyond clean benchmark environments.

recommendation.zh: 只看算法定义和 credit assignment 实验即可；若图结构优势估计稳定，值得在内部长程 agent RL 里复现。
recommendation.en: Read the algorithm and credit-assignment ablations; if the graph-based estimator is stable, it is worth reproducing in internal long-horizon agent RL.

paper.title: Closing the Reflection Gap: A Free Calibration Bonus for Agentic RL
paper.abstract: LLMs are increasingly deployed as agents that interact with external environments and observe feedback such as execution results, error messages, and tool outputs. A well-functioning agent should be able to leverage this feedback to accurately assess its own performance. Yet we find a persistent reflection gap: LLM agents tend to mis-assess their own outputs after observing concrete environment feedback -- even for questions they correctly answered -- and standard RL barely helps due to a credit

summary.core_problem: LLM智能体在观察到环境反馈（如执行结果、错误信息、工具输出）后，仍无法准确评估自身输出的正确性，存在持续的反射缺口——除已知的过度自信外，更突出的是自信不足（将正确答案标记为错误），而标准的仅基于结果的RL因信用分配不匹配，不仅无法解决该问题，反而会训练智能体抑制诚实的错误标记。
summary.importance: 揭示了主流智能体RL流水线的结构性缺陷：仅优化任务结果，不校准反馈后的自我评估。提出的无额外成本的校准奖励方案无需额外标注、奖励模型或LLM裁判，可直接集成到GRPO等主流RL算法中，同时提升任务性能与校准能力。校准后的反射可作为伪奖励支撑无结果监督的自改进，也可用于测试时选择性预测，对智能体后训练的奖励信号设计有明确参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出RefGRPO算法，在标准仅结果RL基础上增加两个核心设计：1）免费校准奖励：RL训练时已同时获得智能体的反馈后二元反射结果s_ref与真实任务结果r，在组归一化前向结果奖励中加入校准项c=I(s_ref=r)，使校准准确的轨迹无论任务成功与否都获得更高相对优势；2）校准系数α(t)动态调度：初始值较大以优先学习校准，后续逐渐衰减，让模型后期聚焦任务性能同时保留校准能力。同时引入统计学习中的ChowScore作为统一度量任务精度与反射校准的指标。
summary.experiments: 基于Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct在多轮text-to-SQL设置上测试。与GRPO基线相比，RefGRPO将自信不足率（被标记为错误的答案中实际正确的比例）从44.4%降至7.7%，任务准确率从75.1%提升至76.5%，ChowScore从73.0%提升至76.5%。额外实验验证了校准后的反射可作为伪奖励实现无结果监督的自改进，以及提升测试时选择性预测的效果。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先关注第1节中反射缺口的定义与实证现象（尤其是图2的错误分布）、第3节的RefGRPO两项核心设计、第4节的主要实验结果与ChowScore定义，预计阅读时间15-20分钟。若需深挖可查看第3.1节的信用分配不匹配机制分析，以及第4.3、4.4节的校准反射下游应用实验。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM agents fail to accurately self-assess output correctness even after observing concrete environment feedback (e.g., execution results, error messages, tool outputs), exhibiting a persistent reflection gap. Beyond documented overconfidence, a more severe underconfidence pattern dominates: agents flag correct answers as incorrect. Standard outcome-only reinforcement learning (RL) cannot resolve this flaw due to structural credit-assignment mismatch, and even trains agents to suppress honest error flags.
summary_en.importance: A previously overlooked structural flaw in mainstream agentic RL pipelines is exposed: pipelines optimize only for task outcomes without calibrating post-feedback self-assessment. The proposed calibration mechanism requires no additional annotation, reward model, or LLM judge, can be directly integrated into popular RL algorithms like GRPO, and improves both task performance and calibration. Calibrated reflections also enable pseudo-reward based self-improvement without outcome supervision and test-time selective prediction, offering actionable insights for reward signal design in agent post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The RefGRPO algorithm extends standard outcome-only RL with two core components: 1) A free calibration bonus: during RL training, both the agent's post-feedback binary reflection score \(s^{\text{ref}}\) and ground-truth task outcome \(r\) are already available. An indicator bonus \(c = \mathbb{I}(s^{\text{ref}} = r)\) is added to the outcome reward before group normalization, granting higher relative advantage to well-calibrated rollouts regardless of task success. 2) A dynamic schedule for the calibration coefficient \(\alpha(t)\): initialized to a large value to prioritize early calibration learning, then decayed gradually to shift focus to task performance while retaining calibration ability. The ChowScore from statistical learning is introduced as a unified metric for joint evaluation of task accuracy and reflection calibration.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on a multi-turn text-to-SQL setup with Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct. Compared to the GRPO baseline, RefGRPO reduces underconfidence rate (share of correct answers flagged as incorrect) from 44.4% to 7.7%, improves task accuracy from 75.1% to 76.5%, and lifts ChowScore from 73.0% to 76.5%. Additional experiments validate that calibrated reflections support self-improvement via pseudo-rewards without outcome supervision, and improve test-time selective prediction performance.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming: start with the definition and empirical observation of the reflection gap in Section 1 (especially Figure 2 for error breakdown), then the two core designs of RefGRPO in Section 3, and main results plus ChowScore definition in Section 4; estimated reading time 15-20 minutes. For deeper exploration, see the credit-assignment mismatch analysis in Section 3.1, and downstream application experiments in Sections 4.3-4.4.

recommendation.zh: 针对 Agentic RL 中自我反思能力的改进，提出了一种无需额外 RM 的内在校准 reward，对于关注 RL post-training 机制和自我对齐的研究员值得一读。
recommendation.en: An improvement on self-reflection capabilities in Agentic RL, proposing an intrinsic calibration reward that requires no additional RM. Worth a read for researchers focused on RL post-training mechanisms and self-alignment.

paper.title: From Verdict to Process: Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Stage Fact Verification
paper.abstract: Recent approaches combining Large Language Models (LLMs) with retrieval-augmented reasoning have shown promise for automated fact verification. To process complex claims, these verification pipelines typically execute multi-stage workflows that coordinate tightly coupled modules, including claim decomposition, evidence gathering, and verdict prediction. However, existing methods optimize individual stages in isolation or rely on fixed heuristics, which limits adaptive coordination among stages a

summary.core_problem: 解决复杂事实核查流水线中 claim decomposition、evidence seeking、answer generation 和 verdict prediction 各阶段被孤立优化，导致整体轨迹协调不佳的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agentic RL 方法，用过程奖励优化多阶段检索增强推理轨迹。它不是预训练工作，但对 RL 训练信号设计、process supervision、agent pipeline 端到端优化有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ProFact，将多阶段事实核查看作一个统一策略的轨迹优化问题。模型学习协调 claim decomposition、证据检索、答案生成和最终 verdict；为缓解最终真假标签带来的稀疏延迟监督，引入 process-aware rewards，在中间阶段提供学习信号。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出数据集名称、模型规模、检索器配置、RL 算法、baseline 或具体提升幅度。实验目标是验证端到端 agentic RL 相比单阶段优化或固定启发式流程能改善事实核查效果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses poor coordination in multi-stage fact verification pipelines where decomposition, evidence gathering, generation, and verdict prediction are optimized separately.
summary_en.importance: This is an agentic RL contribution focused on process supervision for retrieval-augmented reasoning. It is not pretraining work, but it offers a useful signal-design pattern for training multi-step LLM systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: ProFact trains a unified policy over the full verification trajectory, coordinating claim decomposition, evidence seeking, answer generation, and final verdict prediction. To handle sparse delayed supervision from final labels, it adds process-aware rewards at intermediate stages.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify datasets, model sizes, retriever setup, RL algorithm details, baselines, or numerical gains. The intended comparison is against isolated stage optimization and fixed heuristic workflows.

recommendation.zh: 只看 process reward 设计即可；若实验细节缺失，结论只能当 agent RL 信号工程的弱证据。
recommendation.en: Read only the process-reward design; without clean experimental details, treat it as weak evidence for agent RL signal engineering.

paper.title: TRACE: A Unified Rollout Budget Allocation Framework for Efficient Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is a promising approach for enhancing reasoning and agentic behavior in large language models. However, rollout-intensive policy optimization is often limited by insufficient reward contrast, arising when overly simple or complex prompts generate low-variance feedback and when outcome-only rewards assign the same terminal assessment to every decision in a multi-turn rollout. Past efforts have focused on allocating available rollout resources

summary.core_problem: 在 RLVR（verifiable reward）做多轮 ReAct 式 agent 强化学习时，rollout 很贵，但“有效学习信号”并不均匀：有的 prompt 太易/太难导致终局奖励几乎无方差；同一条长轨迹里，不同 turn 的前缀对最终成败的“可分叉性/可对比性”差异很大。论文要解决的是：在固定 rollout 预算下，如何同时在 prompt 根节点和轨迹内部前缀节点上分配采样与分叉预算，最大化可用于策略优化的 reward contrast，从而提升样本效率。
summary.importance: 对 pretrain 研究的直接关联不在“预训练本身”，而在 pretrain↔posttrain 闭环里 RLVR 的工程化：它把 rollout 预算分配从“只选 prompt/只调每个 prompt 的 rollout 数”推进到“树状 rollout + 前缀级分叉”的统一框架，目标是把 outcome-only reward 变成更密的、可用于偏好/对比学习的隐式信号。对做推理/agent 强化学习的团队，价值主要体现在：同等算力下更高的 reward 方差与更强的 credit signal，通常意味着更快的对齐/推理能力爬升；对做持续训练/continual post-train 的团队，价值在于把预算花在“更可能产生正负样本对”的节点上，减少无效长轨迹。
summary.technical_approach:
核心建模是把 rollout 视为一棵树而不是一条链：根是 prompt，内部节点是每个 ReAct turn 的前缀（thought-action-observation 作为语义节点），在某些前缀处追加分叉继续采样，形成 sibling 轨迹。

统一目标是“mixed-reward contrast construction”：对一个候选锚点（根或前缀），看它的后代集合里同时出现成功与失败的概率是否高；高则该锚点值得分配更多预算，因为能产生对比性的终局 outcome，从而构造偏好对/对比对，缓解 outcome-only reward 的稀疏 credit assignment。

算法上分两阶段：
1) 全局 root allocation：在大候选 prompt 池里，给每个 prompt 分配 0 或正的 root rollout 预算（0 相当于过滤），倾向于把预算给“成功概率不极端”的 prompt（既不是几乎必成也不是几乎必败），以获得更高的终局方差。
2) 局部 tree expansion：对已采到的 rollout，枚举其中出现的前缀节点，预测在该前缀条件下继续采样的成功概率；优先在“条件成功率接近 0.5、且有望产生相反 outcome sibling”的前缀上加分叉。

关键实现件是一个可泛化的 success-probability predictor：输入是 prefix history（多轮交互历史），输出条件成功概率，用它来近似每个锚点的“后代混合度”效用，并在预算约束下做分配。与以往只在 prompt 级别做 selection/allocation 的区别在于：它显式利用多轮交互暴露出的语义前缀作为可操作的分配单元，把“多采几条独立轨迹”变成“在信息密度高的 turn 上做 counterfactual branching”。
summary.experiments:
全文实验覆盖三类 agentic 设置：数学推理、多跳 QA、函数调用。主结论是：在相同 rollout 预算下，TRACE 相比 uniform sampling 能提升最终准确率，原因来自更高的 mixed terminal outcomes（正负样本更均衡）与更有效的隐式偏好对构造。

但在当前提供的全文片段中，尚未包含可核对的具体表格数字（模型规模、预算大小、提升幅度、消融细节）。如果需要“参数量/数据规模/提升百分比”等精确数字，需要补充论文的实验章节与表格页（尤其是主结果表、预算-性能曲线、以及 predictor/分配策略的消融）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction + Figure 1：把“rollout 从链到树、分配从 root 到 prefix”的问题设定吃透。
- 再看方法部分里 root allocation 与 prefix expansion 的效用函数推导：重点是他们如何用“后代集合同时含成功/失败”的目标把 prompt 选择、rollout 数分配、前缀分叉统一起来。
- 最后看实验：优先找预算固定下的主结果表、以及消融（只做 root、不做 prefix；不同 predictor；不同分配准则）。阅读时要特别留意：predictor 的训练数据来源（在线/离线、是否引入偏差）、以及树状采样对 on-policy/off-policy 的影响与稳定性处理。

summary_en.core_problem: RL with verifiable rewards (outcome-only RLVR) for multi-turn ReAct-style agents is rollout-expensive, yet the learning signal is highly uneven: many prompts yield near-deterministic terminal rewards (too easy/hard), and within a long trajectory, different turn-level prefixes differ drastically in how likely alternative continuations can flip the final outcome. The paper addresses how to allocate a fixed rollout budget not only across prompts (roots) but also across within-trajectory prefixes (turn nodes), to maximize reward contrast and improve sample efficiency.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it matters for the pretrain↔post-train loop where RLVR is used to push reasoning/agentic behavior. The main contribution is reframing rollout collection as a budgeted tree expansion problem and unifying prompt filtering, per-prompt rollout allocation, and prefix-level branching under a single “mixed-outcome contrast” objective. Practically, it aims to turn sparse outcome rewards into denser implicit preference/contrast signals, improving compute efficiency for agent RL pipelines and making long rollouts less wasteful.
summary_en.technical_approach:
TRACE treats rollouts as trees rather than atomic trajectories. The root is the prompt; each ReAct turn (thought–action–observation) forms a semantically meaningful node/prefix that can be revisited and branched. Budget allocation is defined over these anchors (roots and internal prefixes).

The guiding principle is mixed-reward contrast construction: allocate more budget to anchors whose descendant continuations are likely to contain both successes and failures, because such anchors can generate sibling trajectories with opposite terminal outcomes, yielding stronger contrast for credit assignment under outcome-only rewards.

The framework has two stages:
1) Global root allocation over a large prompt pool: decide which prompts get zero vs positive rollout budget, favoring prompts with non-extreme success probabilities to increase terminal reward variance.
2) Local tree expansion: given collected rollouts, score encountered prefix nodes and allocate additional continuation branches to prefixes likely to produce outcome-diverse descendants.

A shared success-probability predictor estimates conditional success probability from prefix histories and is used to approximate each anchor’s utility under the descendant-set objective. Compared to prior work that allocates only at the prompt level (selection / per-prompt rollout counts), TRACE introduces turn-level branching as a first-class budget decision, effectively performing counterfactual exploration where it is most likely to change outcomes.
summary_en.experiments:
Experiments are reported across three agentic settings (math reasoning, multi-hop QA, function calling). The claimed result is higher accuracy than uniform sampling under the same rollout budget, attributed to generating more mixed terminal outcomes and better implicit preference pairs from the rollout trees.

However, the provided full-text excerpt does not include the concrete numbers (model sizes, exact budgets, absolute/relative gains, or key ablations). To report precise figures, the experiment section/tables (main results, budget–performance curves, and ablations on root-only vs root+prefix, predictor variants, and allocation utilities) are needed.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 minutes):
- Introduction + Figure 1 to lock in the “trajectory → tree” reframing and why prefix-level branching matters for outcome-only RLVR.
- Method section on the descendant-set/mixed-outcome utility and how it yields both root allocation and prefix expansion; focus on what the predictor estimates and how budget constraints are enforced.
- Experiments: look for fixed-budget comparisons, and ablations isolating (i) root allocation, (ii) prefix branching, (iii) predictor quality. Pay attention to how the predictor is trained (online/offline, bias) and any stability considerations when using tree-structured samples for policy optimization.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得从“训练信号密度”而不是 agent 花活去看；若实验干净，它会改变你只在 prompt 级做 RL 采样分配的默认做法，先看 allocation 定义和 sample-efficiency 图。
recommendation.en: Read this as a signal-density paper, not an agent gimmick; if the setup is clean, it should update your default from prompt-level to prefix-level rollout allocation in RL.

paper.title: EvoTrainer: Co-Evolving LLM Policies and Training Harnesses for Autonomous Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Autonomous LLM training is often framed as recipe search, which leaves the training harness largely static. This limitation sharpens in agentic RL, where shifting bottlenecks and scalar rewards mask diverse failure modes. We introduce EvoTrainer, an autonomous training framework that co-evolves LLM policies and training-side harnesses through empirical feedback: it diagnoses rollout-level evidence, revises diagnostics, backtests interventions, and accumulates reusable skills. Evaluated on mathem

summary.core_problem: 在 Agentic RL 中，传统的自动化训练框架通常保持诊断和评估工具（Harness）固定，无法适应训练过程中不断变化的瓶颈和复杂的失败模式。
summary.importance: 提出了一种将策略模型与训练侧诊断工具协同进化的新范式，突破了仅搜索训练配方的局限，为复杂 Agent 任务的自动化 RL 训练提供了新思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出了 EvoTrainer 框架，包含两个耦合过程：1) 策略自我进化：生成、比较、修剪和合并训练版本；2) 训练器自我反思：当现有指标或分析工具不足时，进化训练侧的 Harness（如诊断脚本、回测机制）。通过持久化记忆和可复用技能库，积累跨版本的经验。
summary.experiments: 在数学推理、代码生成和仓库级软件工程（SWE）任务上评估。EvoTrainer 均优于无 RL 基线，并在相同设定下匹配或超越了人工设计的 RL 基线。在最复杂的 SWE-9B 任务上提升最大（38.16% vs 人工RL的 33.77%）。分析表明，进化的 Harness 能有效拒绝高分但无效的分支。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读第 3 节关于 EvoTrainer 协同进化机制的设计（特别是 Harness 进化的具体实现），以及第 4 节在 SWE 任务上的实验结果和过程分析。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In Agentic RL, traditional autonomous training frameworks keep diagnostic and evaluation harnesses static, failing to adapt to shifting bottlenecks and complex failure modes during training.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a novel paradigm of co-evolving policy models with training-side diagnostic harnesses, breaking the limitation of merely searching training recipes, and offering a new approach for autonomous RL in complex agent tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduced EvoTrainer, a framework with two coupled processes: 1) Policy self-evolution: generating, comparing, pruning, and merging training versions; 2) Trainer self-reflection: evolving the training-side harness (e.g., diagnostic scripts, backtests) when existing metrics are insufficient. It uses persistent memory and a reusable skill library to accumulate cross-version experience.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on math reasoning, code generation, and repo-level SWE. EvoTrainer consistently outperformed no-RL baselines and matched or exceeded human-engineered RL baselines under the same settings. The largest gain was on SWE-9B (38.16% vs. human RL's 33.77%). Analysis shows the evolving harness effectively rejects invalid high-scoring branches.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the design of EvoTrainer's co-evolution mechanism (especially the implementation of harness evolution), and Section 4 for experimental results and process analysis on the SWE task. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 将 RL 的训练环境/脚手架也纳入进化搜索的范畴（co-evolution），在长视距 SWE 任务上效果显著，对探索超越静态 reward 模型的 RL 范式有启发。
recommendation.en: Incorporates the RL training environment/harness into evolutionary search (co-evolution), showing significant gains on long-horizon SWE tasks. Inspiring for exploring RL paradigms beyond static reward models.

institutions: Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences

paper.title: Tool-Aware Optimization with Entropy Guidance for Efficient Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) equips large language models (LLMs) with tool-use capabilities that substantially improve reasoning on complex tasks. However, integrating external tools often destabilizes training: over-reliance on tools can induce input distribution shift, while overly conservative tool use limits effective exploration. To address this issue, we propose a unified framework TAO-RL that couples tool-aware trajectory filtering with entropy-guided exploration for efficient poli

summary.core_problem: 在 Agentic RL（工具调用强化学习）中，工具执行结果的注入会导致输入分布发生剧烈偏移，从而破坏策略优化的稳定性；而过度保守的工具使用策略又会限制模型的有效探索。
summary.importance: 提出了一种在数据层面和算法层面联合优化的框架，为解决工具调用场景下 RL 训练的不稳定性和探索效率问题提供了新的思路，对提升 LLM 的复杂推理能力具有启发意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 TAO-RL 框架，结合了数据层面的轨迹过滤和算法层面的熵引导探索。数据层面：过滤掉所有工具调用失败的轨迹，以及所有 rollout 结果全对或全错的轨迹，以构建高质量、有区分度的训练分布。算法层面：在过滤后的数据上，识别工具调用后且具有高熵的 token 作为关键决策点，并施加目标熵奖励，鼓励模型在关键位置进行探索。
summary.experiments: 在七个数学推理基准测试和三个不同规模的基座模型上进行了实验，结果表明 TAO-RL 能够持续优于现有方法，在提升推理性能的同时保持了训练的稳定性。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点关注 Section IV 中关于轨迹过滤条件的设计和熵引导探索奖励的计算方式，以及 Section V 中的消融实验，了解各组件对最终性能的贡献。

summary_en.core_problem: In Agentic RL, injecting tool execution results causes severe input distribution shifts, destabilizing policy optimization, while overly conservative tool use limits effective exploration.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a joint optimization framework at both data and algorithmic levels, offering a new perspective on addressing training instability and exploration efficiency in tool-use scenarios, which is inspiring for enhancing LLMs' complex reasoning capabilities.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the TAO-RL framework, coupling data-level trajectory filtering with algorithm-level entropy-guided exploration. Data level: filters out trajectories where all tool invocations fail, and those where all rollouts are either all correct or all incorrect, to construct a high-quality, discriminative training distribution. Algorithmic level: on the filtered data, identifies post-tool-call tokens with high entropy as critical decision points and applies targeted entropy bonuses to encourage exploration at these key positions.
summary_en.experiments: Conducted experiments on seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks across three base model scales, demonstrating that TAO-RL consistently outperforms existing methods, improving reasoning performance while maintaining training stability.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section IV for the design of trajectory filtering criteria and the calculation of the entropy-guided exploration bonus, and Section V for ablation studies to understand the contribution of each component.

recommendation.zh: 工具感知的轨迹过滤设计对RL阶段的训练数据质量提升有参考价值，只看数据过滤准则部分即可
recommendation.en: The tool-aware trajectory filtering design has reference value for improving training data quality in the RL stage, only the data filtering criteria section needs to be read

institutions: State Key Laboratory for Novel Software Technology, Nanjing University
with the National Key Laboratory for Novel Software Technology
